mapper.select: SELECT FROM metal_production_line r LEFT JOIN metal_factory f ON f.factory_id=r.factory_id AND f.del_flag='0' WHERE 1=1 AND r.factory_id=#{factoryId} ORDER BY r.production_line_id DESC
SELECT FROM metal_production_line r LEFT JOIN metal_factory f ON f.factory_id=r.factory_id AND f.del_flag='0' WHERE 1=1 AND r.production_line_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM metal_production_line r LEFT JOIN metal_factory f ON f.factory_id=r.factory_id AND f.del_flag='0' WHERE 1=1 AND r.production_line_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE metal_production_line SET production_line_code=#{code},production_line_name=#{name},factory_id=#{factoryId},version=version+1,update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=NOW() WHERE production_line_id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
